indications: primary insomnia in adults >=55 years (licensed formulation 2 mg prolonged-release, e.g. Circadin)
sleep-onset insomnia in children/adolescents with neurodevelopmental disorders (unlicensed in most, licensed in some settings)

dosing.adult_55plus_insomnia: 2 mg prolonged-release, 1-2 hours before bed, after food, for up to 13 weeks; continue longer if response good
dosing.children: 1-2 mg (up to 3 mg in some protocols) 30-60 min before bedtime
